The Moat

Navigation gets us in.
Footfall data keeps us there.

Every session feeds footfall heatmaps, dwell-time, and route data no one else has. A venue can move a tenant and prove it drove the traffic, or catch a bottleneck before it becomes a crowd problem. The longer we run, the harder we are to replace.

Business Model

Three revenue lines per venue.

A recurring license, a cut of the promotions the venue sells to its own tenants, and an analytics upsell. The license is affordable; the longer they run it, the harder we are to replace.

Venue License
$10.8k–14.4k
Annual recurring per venue. Scales with size: the bigger the building, the more it's worth.

Tenant Revenue-Share
20–30%
